parties: Dhanpal Doshi (acquirer); Indo Thai Securities Limited (target)
headline: Dhanpal Doshi files substantial acquisition disclosure for Indo Thai Securities under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Dhanpal Doshi has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a material acquisition of shares in Indo Thai Securities Limited. The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure of the acquirer's shareholding and intent.
detail: Dhanpal Doshi submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on or around 16–19 June 2026 concerning substantial acquisition of shares in Indo Thai Securities Limited. Regulation 31(4) requires an acquirer to disclose to the exchange within 2 trading days of crossing a threshold (typically 5% or acquisition of control). The disclosure sets a timeline for the open offer (if triggered) and investor protection notice.
